positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Administered the Healthcare EDI Clearinghouse: Managed the secure transmission and validation of EDI X12 claim files between providers (hospitals, clinics, and long-term care facilities), payers, and external clearinghouses.
Optimized Claims and Remittance Lifecycle: Streamlined the intake, tracking, and routing of claim responses, payment authorizations, and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) to ensure timely reimbursement.
Managed Eligibility Workflows: Maintained and monitored ongoing patient eligibility requests and responses (such as the 270/271 transaction sets) between clients and insurance payers.
Maintained Direct Data Entry (DDE): Sustained and supported DDE processes and screen-scraping workflows to enable efficient data extraction and system-to-system translation.
Software Development & QA: Designed, developed, and tested new application features to expand and enhance the capabilities of the core clearinghouse system.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintain the Clearinghouse System that receives Healthcare claim files (EDI X12) from Hospitals, Long Term Care facilities and Doctors Offices, validates and sends them to insurance companies and other clearinghouses.
Handle claim responses and  payment/advice from insurance companies and other clearinghouses and send them back to customers.
Maintain eligibility requests and responses process
Maintain transmission process from clients to insurance companies and other clearinghouses.
Maintain DDE process (screen scraping).
Design, develop, and test new applications for the existing system.
